Data.name: framework nLab
single_source_rules: Framework version exists only here.
Canonical framework paths exist only in this manifest.
Artifact versions belong to artifacts.
Allowed metadata.json_type values belong only to json-types.json.
Allowed metadata.scope values belong only to metadata.schema.json.
Action semantics belong only to button-registry.json.
Icon identity belongs only to icon-registry.json.
Dynamic compact textual SVG marks are generated from dynamic-svg-text and are not duplicated as per-number icons.
Field presentation semantics belong to field-renderers.json; project configuration only selects/overrides registered renderers.
Reference records keep stable IDs canonical while UI may display ID, human label, or both.
Data-editor semantic state colors belong to data-editor-semantic-theme.json and are layered over visual themes.
Input behavior shared by forms and search belongs to input-profiles.json.
Hierarchical option semantics belong to hierarchical-options.json; menus/dropdowns are generated from data rather than hard-coded lists.
Button visual templates belong only to button-templates.json.
Visual token semantics belong only to design-tokens.json.
Theme availability and default theme belong only to theme-registry.json.
Theme context assignment belongs only to theme-contexts.json.
Data backend semantics belong only to data-access-contract.json.
Client persistence policy belongs only to client-storage-policy.json and client-persistence.json.
Personal/private storage semantics belong only to personal-storage-contract.json; provider-specific mappings live only in provider adapters.
Form collection and form transport are separate contracts; submission capability belongs to form-submission.json.
Survey definitions and branching belong to survey-flow.json/runtime; transport remains delegated to form-submission.json and business questions remain project data.
Automatic/manual value-resolution semantics belong only to value-resolution.json and its schema.
Public editorial field structure belongs only to editorial.schema.json; actual editorial content belongs to project/source data or help-registry as appropriate.
Public contextual-help wording belongs only to help-registry.json.
Schemas define field contracts and generate data dictionaries.
Dev help derives technical facts from canonical metadata, schemas, registries, data-access and composition instead of copying them.
Primitive UI mechanics are composed instead of duplicated.
QR static and browser generation share one logical configuration contract.
PDF static and browser generation share view-model/theme semantics; full-page bitmap capture is not the default export path.
HTML and PDF may use different registered view variants for the same logical data without duplicating the source data.
Structured JSON editing, rendering, validation and export share one canonical data state through the structured-data engine.
Whole-document and single-record JSON import/export use the same editor state and validation contracts.
Browser-selected media uses temporary preview URLs only for preview; exported JSON keeps stable project paths and persistent file copying remains provider-adapter responsibility.
Structured data business logic lives in structured-data-engine.js; demo/editor pages are UI adapters and must not fork reference/search/hierarchy/import-export rules.

versioning.release_manifests: historical snapshots archived outside active framework; never canonical

governance.schema_validation: required for every active framework JSON artifact
governance.documentation_generation: public help registry + metadata + schema + registry + generated dev overlay

dictionnaire_donnees.note: V1.14 ajoute un moteur experimental de sondages/questionnaires conditionnels compose avec les primitives de formulaire existantes.
